edits.current: THE ROLLING SIX-MONTH AVERAGE that drives the ET art. 206 num. 4 severance exemption and its taper. Severance savings and the interest on them are EXEMPT IN FULL where this average does not exceed 350 UVT (COP 18,330,900 per month in 2026), and tapered above it. THE ENGINE MUST MAINTAIN THIS AVERAGE YEAR-ROUND - it cannot be reconstructed at year end from annual totals because it is a moving six-month window, and on a termination it is the average of the last six months OF EMPLOYMENT.
edits.proposed: THE ROLLING SIX-MONTH AVERAGE that drives the ET art. 206 num. 4 severance exemption and its taper. Severance savings and the interest on them are EXEMPT IN FULL where this average does not exceed 350 UVT (COP 18,330,900 per month in 2026), and tapered above it. THE ENGINE MUST MAINTAIN THIS AVERAGE YEAR-ROUND - it cannot be reconstructed at year end from annual totals because it is a moving six-month window, and on a termination it is the average of the last six months OF EMPLOYMENT. HOW THE AVERAGE IS TAKEN: the monthly average SALARY ('salario mensual promedio', ET art. 206 num. 4) of six months - on termination or on a withdrawal of severance, the last six months of employment or the six months before the withdrawal; while the employment continues, the six months of the immediately preceding year at the time of the deposit to the fund; for employees outside the Ley 50 de 1990 regime, the six months before the employer recognises the severance (ET art. 27 num. 3) (DIAN Concepto 4443 de 2025).

edits.current: Voluntary contributions to voluntary pension funds under ET art. 126-1 and DUR 1625 de 2016 art. 1.2.1.22.41. Shares the ET art. 336 40% / 1,340-UVT annual cap with AFC and AVC. SOURCE: wage types 25811 Pension Voluntaria Porvenir (FVOL), 25812 Pension Voluntaria Proteccion (FVOL), 25813 Pension Voluntaria Skandia (FVOL), 25814 Pensiones Voluntarias Metlife (FVOL), 25815 Dafuturo (FVOL) and 25823 Pension Voluntaria colfondos (FVOL). Wage type 21193 Foncoltabaco voluntary contribution is a contribution to an employee fund, not to a pension fund, and is not certified here. Because several of these fund managers also run mandatory RAIS accounts, the engine must tag each voluntary contribution as RAIS (casilla 55) or voluntary fund (casilla 56); the tag is carried on the wage type.

Because several of these fund managers also run mandatory RAIS accounts, the engine must tag each voluntary contribution as RAIS (casilla 55) or voluntary fund (casilla 56); the tag is carried on the wage type.

edits.current: THE FIRST OF THREE SEVERANCE LINES. Severance savings and the interest on them ACTUALLY PAID to the employee in the period - typically the January interest payment and any authorised partial withdrawal or termination settlement. Excluded from the monthly withholding base under ET art. 206 num. 4 but still certified here. SOURCE: wage types 62110 Cash-out of Severance Pay - Social Benefits -541S and 62117 Cash-out of Interest Severance Pay - Social Benefits-541R (termination and settlement payments), 62126 Advance Severance Last Year (authorised partial payments) and 62127 Advance Interest Severance Pay (the annual interest on severance, paid in January). Provision wage types (22110, 22112, 42110, 42112) and balance wage types (63814, 63815, 64999, 68028) are accruals or balances, not payments, and are not certified here. An employee on integral salary (WT 62140 Integral Salary) accrues no cesantias and no interest for the time on integral salary (CST art. 132 num. 2), so nothing is certified here for that time, including on termination; only cesantias and interest settled for the service before the conversion to integral salary (CST art. 132 num. 4) are certified here. The integral salary itself is certified in full in casilla 36. Interest on cesantias is paid with every direct payment of cesantias - WT 62117 on termination, or within the month following a partial settlement (Ley 52 de 1975 art. 1) - and not only as the January interest of WT 62127.

edits.current: Statutory benefits OTHER THAN severance savings and the interest on them. The instruction guide (Res. 000022/2024) lists service bonus, vacaciones and work clothing among them, and directs expressly that severance savings paid to the employee go to casilla 47 and severance savings deposited to the fund go elsewhere. VACATION PAY is certified here: wage types 79401 Annual leave payout, 62116 Vacation Terminations and 62150 Vacation Bonus, which carry the 'Salary Payment Indicator' attribute and are nonetheless certified here and not in casilla 36, under the casilla-36 exclusion rule. RECORDED DEFECT: the instruction guide for THIS casilla says the deposited severance goes to 'la casilla 48', but the form's own printed label makes casilla 48 the TRADITIONAL-REGIME severance and casilla 49 the amount deposited to the fund. The form layout is authoritative.

edits.current: Where the employer pays a THIRD PARTY for the employee's or their family's meals - a restaurant, own or third-party, or vouchers for food - the payment is deductible for the employer and is NOT income for the employee but for the supplier, PROVIDED the employee's salary does not exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 per month in 2026). Where the monthly payments exceed 41 UVT (COP 2,147,334 in 2026), THE EXCESS is taxable income of the employee and is withheld as employment income. The instruction guide adds that the rule does not apply to company representation expenses, which remain deductible. Do NOT include amounts already in casilla 36. SOURCE: wage type 65818 Meal Allowance Inf.-2079, taken per employee per month. Run the test MONTH BY MONTH per employee: the month's meal payment against 41 UVT and the employee's monthly salary against 310 UVT, using the UVT parameter of the tax year (52,374 for 2026); do NOT read the UVT from wage type 58001 UVT, which is a per-run payroll amount and is multiplied in months with more than one payroll run or a retro run. The casilla is the sum of the monthly excesses over the tax year.

edits.current: The employee's mandatory pension contributions AND the solidarity-fund surcharge, TAKEN TOGETHER IN ONE CASILLA. Note the asymmetry with the electronic payroll, which insists on reporting them as separate elements (NIE166 for pension, NIE168 and NIE170 for the two solidarity sub-accounts). The engine must keep them separate internally and sum them only here. SOURCE: 2556 Pension Plan Mandatory - AFP Employee + 2553 Solidarity Pension Fund (+ 21643 Solidarity Pension Fund-Pensioner for pension payees). A combined health + pension + solidarity contributions total cannot split casillas 53 and 54; take the wage types individually.

edits.current: THE PRINCIPAL WITHHOLDING CASILLA. Total withholding at source ACTUALLY PRACTISED on this employee's work and pension income during the certified period; no hypothetical, theoretical or contingent amount is certified (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024). Feeds casilla 75 together with casilla 74. Must reconcile to twelve months of electronic payroll NIE177 for this employee, and the sum of casilla 60 across all employees must reconcile to twelve months of Form 350 casilla 93 - allowing for the rounding conventions. SOURCE: the withholding practised is wage type 2552 Income Tax (employee) plus 21129 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Terminations- 541T (a separate deduction on termination payments, which can coexist with 2552 in the same month) and 21140 Personal Income Tax Withholding-Retirees- 6799. Wage types 21330 Personal Income Tax Withholding (Theoretical) and 25834 Hypothetical Witholding Tax  - IC Foreign Country are notional, not withholding practised, and are NOT certified; the same exclusion applies to every wage type that computes a theoretical, hypothetical or contingent withholding. Wage types 25832 / 65832 Witholding Tax on Stock awards and 25833 Witholding Tax  - IC Local Country are certified here where the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC) classifies the wage type as withholding actually deducted from the employee's income, and are excluded where it classifies the wage type as theoretical, hypothetical, contingent or informative; the withholding-practised attribute of each comes from the WTC. Only the withholding actually deducted is certified: a comparison result computed without the contribution depuration, and any contingent withholding derived from it, is not part of 2552 and is not certified. Sum January to December of the tax year; never a rolling 12-month total.

edits.current: Total salary payments ACTUALLY MADE in the period to a resident natural person whose income derives from an employment or statutory relationship. The instruction guide (Res. 000022/2024) quotes CST art. 127 in full: salary is not only the ordinary fixed or variable remuneration but everything the employee receives in money or in kind as direct consideration for the service - primas, sobresueldos, habitual bonuses, overtime, work on mandatory rest days, sales percentages and commissions. EXCLUSION RULE: do NOT include here any value belonging in casillas 38 to 46. SOURCE: salary wage types 62100 Ordinary Salary, 62101 Arrears - Ordinary salary, 62140 Integral Salary (the full integral salary, including the factor prestacional), 62141 Arrears-Integral Salary, 62118 Incentive Compensation - IC Local Country, 62133 Variable, 62113 Weekend payoff and 62841 / 62842 / 62845 overtime and night, Sunday or holiday surcharges. BONUSES: HABITUAL bonuses are salary and are certified here - 62208 March Bonus, 62209 Christmas Bonus, 62210 August Bonus, 62225 Salary Attendance Bonus-Monthly, 62224 Quarterly Salary Attendance Bonus and 62228 Years of Service Bonus - CLA; NON-HABITUAL bonuses are certified in casilla 46 - 62202 Ocassional Bonus Grossed Up (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024). 62229 Years of Service Bonus NON CLA is certified here where habitual and in casilla 46 where not; the habitual attribute of that bonus wage type comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC). PAYMENTS IN KIND: an in-kind payment that is salary under CST art. 127 is certified here and an in-kind payment that is not salary is certified in casilla 46; the salary attribute of each in-kind wage type comes from the WTC (meal payments follow the 310 / 41 UVT test of casillas 37-38). LEAVE PAYOUTS 79405-79419 (marriage, maternity, paternity, sick-leave, bereavement, paid and jury leave payouts) and SALARY PAID ABROAD to expatriates (25830 Salary paid in Foreign Countries, 65838 Incentive Compensation - IC-1001 Foreign Country) follow the same rule as every other earning: certified here where the WTC classifies the wage type as salary and in casilla 46 where it classifies it as non-salary work income. The wage-type attribute 'Salary Payment Indicator' must NOT be used as the casilla-36 rule on its own: it is also set on vacation pay (79401 Annual leave payout, 62116 Vacation Terminations, 62150 Vacation Bonus), which is certified in casilla 42, and on per diems (62805-62808), which are always certified in casilla 43, and on the leave payouts 79405-79419; and it is absent from the bonus wage types 62229, 62224 and 62202 listed above. The engine holds an explicit wage-type-to-casilla table, maintained as a configuration table from the WTC attributes; every earning wage type is assigned. PERIOD: sum the payments made from 1 January to 31 December of the tax year; never a rolling 12-month total.

edits.current: Payments made in electronic or paper service vouchers, cheques, cards or vales - for fuel, school supplies, footwear and clothing, or any other purpose. Deductible for the employer and income for the employee. THREE EXPLICIT NOTES in the instruction guide: (1) INCLUDE meal payments for an employee earning MORE than 310 UVT per month; (2) do NOT include meal payments for an employee earning up to 310 UVT - those go to casilla 38; (3) do NOT include anything already reported in casilla 36. SOURCE: in-kind benefits paid to third parties are booked as informative earning wage types ('Inf.') offset by an equal informative deduction - e.g. 65818 Meal Allowance Inf.-2079 offset by 21115 Meal Allowance Inf. Deduction-2644 - and the same pattern applies to 65811 Gym Allowance Inf.-6969, 65809 / 65839 Optical Allowance Inf, 65812 Text Books Allowance - Inf-6971, 65801 / 65814 / 65815 / 65831 Private Health Insurance Inf and 65817 / 65837 Life Insurance-Inf. The earning side is the certified value; the offsetting deduction wage types are payroll mechanics and are not themselves casilla values. The meal item 65818 is subject to the 41 UVT / 310 UVT test of casillas 37-38, applied month by month: in a month in which the employee's salary exceeds 310 UVT the whole 65818 amount is certified here; in a month in which it does not, nothing is certified here and the excess over 41 UVT goes to casilla 38 (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024; ET art. 387-1). The other in-kind benefit wage types listed above (gym, optical, text books, private health insurance and life insurance) are not subject to the meal test and are not certified here: each is certified in casilla 36 where the WTC classifies the wage type as salary and in casilla 46 where it classifies it as non-salary work income (instruction guide, Res. 000022/2024: casilla 36 covers everything received in kind as direct consideration for the service, casilla 46 the work-income payments with no dedicated casilla); the salary attribute of each in-kind wage type comes from the Wage Type Catalogue (WTC).
